title: Financial Portfolio Profit Maximizer
description: A quantitative analyst is examining the historical daily returns of an emerging asset. The returns can be positive or negative. The analyst wants to identify a contiguous sub-period of trading days that yields the maximum possible cumulative return. Write an algorithm to find the maximum possible sum of a contiguous subarray within a given array of numbers.
input_format: An array of integers representing daily returns.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum cumulative return of a contiguous sub-period.

examples.explanation: The contiguous subarray [4, -1, 2, 1] has the largest sum = 6.
The subarray [1] has the largest sum = 1.
The contiguous subarray [5, 4, -1, 7, 8] has the largest sum = 23.
